name: generation-audit
description: Single entry point for auditing self-authored Claude Code assets when a new Claude model takes a role in your harness — a runtime cross-check against the live system prompt and tool descriptions (conflict / redundancy), plus a dated-pattern scan delegated to Claude Code's bundled /claude-api prompt-audit. Applies High/Medium line fixes under explicit consent and hands whole-asset verdicts to the stocktake skills.
author: shimo4228
